# Kin's Multi-Agents UI (Cockpit)

> Desktop mission-control cockpit designed for autonomous AI pair programming (Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Cursor) with real-time telemetry, 10-phase loop orchestration, and Docker isolation.
> Repository: https://github.com/Creter2608/kins-multiagents-ui

## Architecture & Specifications
- [docs/LOOP.md](docs/LOOP.md): Canonical Autonomous Loop v2.0 state machine (10 phases: INITIALIZE -> SPEC_GATE -> ISOLATE -> DETECT_STACKS -> PLAN -> EXECUTE -> VERIFY -> REALITY_CHECK -> RELEASE_GATE -> COMPLETE).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Core agent operational guidelines, 2-Tier Multi-Agent pipeline, and Karpathy behavioral invariants.
- [README.md](README.md): Repository overview, desktop cockpit architecture, getting started, and container commands.

## Key Operational Invariants
- **2-Tier Multi-Agent Pipeline**: Layer 1 GPT Architect (strategic blueprint & compact assertions) + Layer 2 Gemini 3.8 Flash (native code synthesis & deterministic CPU execution).
- **Anti-Token-Drain**: $0 CPU verification (`npm test`), 32 KiB byte-capped command output, hard cap of 1 retry on test failure.
- **Telemetry HUD**: Live prompt, completion, and cache tracking for GPT (gpt-5.6-sol) and Gemini 3.8 Flash (including thinking/reasoning token accounting).
- **Protected Eval Zone**: `.eval/golden_assertions.json` is read-only and locked by SHA-256 checksum.
- **Execution Isolation**: When `kins_autonomous_sandbox` is active, all shell operations run inside Docker.

## Key Commands
- `npm run app:dev`: Start Vite UI development server.
- `npm run app:start`: Launch Electron desktop cockpit.
- `npm run build`: Full production build (tsc + preload bundling + Vite UI).
- `npm test`: Clean, build, and execute deterministic test suite (55 tests).
- `npm run typecheck`: Strict TypeScript type checking without emitting files.
- `node scripts/ai-loop.mjs verify`: Validate workspace assertions against golden SHA-256.
- `docker exec kins_autonomous_sandbox npm test`: Isolated test execution inside container sandbox.
